ideas.name: Treasury Auction Futures Cycle
ideas.claim: Sell Treasury futures before an auction, reverse to long before the auction, and close afterward.
ideas.quote: The daily trade is the gap itself if you sell the future at the settlement six trade dates before the auction, reverse at the settlement the day before it, and sell at the settlement four trade dates after it.
ideas.mechanism: Auction-related dealer inventory and price pressure

rules.market: ZT around 2-year Treasury auctions; ZF around 5-year Treasury auctions
rules.timeframe: Daily settlements; five trading days on each side
rules.entry: Sell at the settlement six trading dates before the auction; reverse to long at the settlement one trading date before the auction
rules.exit: Sell the long position at the settlement four trading dates after the auction

ideas.claimed_result: June 2010 to September 2026: after one tick per round trip, 2.9 basis points of price per auction for ZT and 7.3 for ZF. The source says the windows were selected while examining this sample.
required_data: Contract roll and transaction cost data

ideas.name: TLT Auction Week Long
ideas.claim: Buy TLT before Treasury auctions and sell afterward, with entry and exit offsets optimized in the test.
ideas.quote: Go long on TLT X days ahead of the auction, sell Y days after.
ideas.mechanism: Primary dealer inventory management around Treasury auctions

rules.entry: Buy X days before an auction; X not stated
rules.exit: Sell Y days after the auction; Y not stated

ideas.claimed_result: The source reports an average daily gain of 0.06% in the assessed holding periods, compared with 0.02% on random days.
